items.headline: RBI Holds Repo Rate Steady at 5.25%, Upgrades GDP Growth Forecast to 6.7%
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India maintained its repo rate at 5.25% in its August 2026 monetary policy meeting, adhering to a neutral stance. The central bank upgraded its GDP growth projection for FY27 to 6.7% from 6.6% and marginally lowered its inflation estimate to 5.0% from 5.1% for the same period.

items.headline: India's Retail Inflation Rises to 4.45% in July, Stays Above RBI's 4% Target
items.summary: Retail inflation for July 2026 increased slightly to 4.45% from 4.38% in June, marking the second consecutive month it has remained above the RBI's 4% target, primarily driven by elevated food, fuel, and transport prices.

items.headline: India Records Unexpected $7.1 Billion Current Account Surplus in Q4 FY26
items.summary: India reported an unexpected current account surplus of $7.1 billion in Q4 FY26 (January-March 2026), equivalent to 0.7% of GDP. This turnaround from a deficit was largely due to robust services exports and record remittance inflows.

items.headline: Government Promotes Surface Coal/Lignite Gasification for Energy Security
items.summary: The Indian government is actively promoting surface coal/lignite gasification projects with a significant outlay aimed at strengthening the nation's energy security.

items.headline: Indian Markets Poised for Muted Opening Amid Mixed Global Cues
items.summary: Indian markets are anticipated to have a muted opening today despite overall positive trends in Asian markets and flat US futures. US stock markets rallied to new all-time highs on cooling inflation and declining oil prices, though geopolitical tensions persist.

items.headline: FIIs Remain Net Sellers for Third Consecutive Session, DIIs Provide Support
items.summary: Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) were net sellers for the third consecutive session, offloading shares worth ₹510.69 crore on August 13, 2026. Conversely, domestic institutional investors (DIIs) provided crucial market support by being net buyers of shares worth ₹4,353.09 crore.

items.headline: Honasa Consumer Reports More Than Doubled Q1 Net Profit Year-on-Year
items.summary: Honasa Consumer announced a Q1 net profit of ₹902 million, more than doubling year-on-year, indicating strong financial performance for the quarter.

items.headline: DCW Q1 Net Profit Triples Year-on-Year to ₹345 Million, Revenue Up to ₹5.4 Billion
items.summary: DCW's Q1 net profit tripled year-on-year to ₹345 million, with revenue increasing to ₹5.4 billion, reflecting robust growth in its latest quarterly results.

items.headline: Modison Experiences 604% Surge in Q1 Net Profit, Revenue Nearly Doubles
items.summary: Modison posted a significant 604% year-on-year surge in Q1 net profit to ₹338 million, accompanied by a nearly doubled revenue, demonstrating exceptional growth.

items.headline: KRBL's Q1 Consolidated Net Profit Rises 73% Driven by EBITDA Margin Expansion
items.summary: KRBL's consolidated net profit increased by 73% in Q1 FY27, primarily due to an 840 basis points widening of its EBITDA margin to 20.56%.

items.headline: Elgi Equipments Reports 20% Growth in Q1 Consolidated Net Profit, Margin Expands
items.summary: Elgi Equipments achieved a 20% growth in its Q1 consolidated net profit, with its EBITDA margin expanding to 14.62%, indicating healthy operational performance.

items.headline: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Q1 Net Profit Plunges 80%, Misses Estimates
items.summary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles reported an 80% year-on-year plunge in Q1 net profit to ₹7.75 billion, falling short of estimates due to significant cost pressures and contracting EBITDA margins.

items.headline: Avanti Feeds Q1 Net Profit Falls 49% Despite Revenue Growth Due to Margin Contraction
items.summary: Avanti Feeds' Q1 net profit declined by 49% despite revenue growth, primarily attributed to a sharp contraction in EBITDA margins within its Shrimp and other Feeds segment.

items.headline: ICRA Analysis Shows Broad-Based Earnings Resilience for India Inc. in Q1 FY27
items.summary: ICRA's analysis of Q1 FY27 results indicates broad-based earnings resilience across India Inc., with aggregate revenues growing 22% year-on-year. However, the oil refining sector's weakness impacted overall operating and net profits.

items.headline: Shipbuilding, Space, and Defence Sectors Lead Market Cap Surges on Thursday
items.summary: On Thursday, the Shipbuilding, Space, and Defence sectors were the top performers in the Indian market, witnessing the most significant surges in market capitalization.

items.headline: Glass Sector Experiences Steepest Decline in Market Cap on Thursday
items.summary: The Glass sector recorded the steepest decline in market capitalization on Thursday, contrasting with the strong performance of other sectors.

items.headline: Mixed Sectoral Performance Anticipated Today; Chemicals, Realty, FMCG to Support
items.summary: Sectoral performance for today is expected to be mixed, with Chemical, Realty, and FMCG sectors likely to provide support, while Metal, Banking, and Healthcare sectors might face weakness.

items.headline: Indian M&A Activity Sees Growth Driven by Reforms and Liberalized Foreign Investment Policy
items.summary: India's M&A activity saw total deal value reach approximately USD 124 billion in 2025, an 18% increase over the previous year, fueled by legislative reforms, a liberalized foreign investment policy, and the introduction of fast-track merger routes.

items.headline: Honasa Consumer, DCW, Modison, KRBL, Elgi Equipments, Max Financial Services, LG Electronics in Focus Post Q1 Results
items.summary: These companies are drawing investor and analyst attention today following the release of their Q1 FY27 earnings results.

items.headline: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles, Avanti Feeds Under Scrutiny Following Weaker Q1 Earnings
items.summary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles and Avanti Feeds are facing scrutiny from investors and analysts after reporting weaker Q1 earnings.

items.headline: Jana Small Finance Bank Recommended 'Buy' by Choice Broking with ₹620 Target
items.summary: Sumeet Bagadia of Choice Broking recommends buying Jana Small Finance Bank (JSFB), citing a strong bullish trend and trading above key moving averages, with a target of ₹620.

items.headline: GHCL Textiles Recommended 'Buy' by Choice Broking Amid Healthy Uptrend
items.summary: Sumeet Bagadia of Choice Broking also recommends buying GHCL Textiles, highlighting its sustained buying momentum and healthy uptrend, currently trading around ₹121.25.

items.headline: Authum Investment, Knowledge Marine, Bharat Seats Recommended 'Buy' by Choice Broking
items.summary: Authum Investment & Infrastructure, Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works, and Bharat Seats are additionally recommended for buying by Sumeet Bagadia of Choice Broking.

items.headline: Shaily Engineering Plastics Highlighted as Growth Stock with Pricing Power by Simply Wall St
items.summary: Simply Wall St identifies Shaily Engineering Plastics as a growth stock possessing pricing power, attributed to its exposure to complex healthcare and consumer plastics and a strong export mix.

items.headline: Tata Consultancy Services Identified as Leading Dividend Income Idea with High ROE
items.summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is recognized as a leading dividend income idea, featuring a 4.7% yield and high ROE, benefiting from AI-heavy contracts despite some pressure on operating margins.

items.headline: Gujarat Energy Noted for Strong Earnings and Dividend Yield in City Gas Distribution
items.summary: Gujarat Energy is highlighted for its strong recent earnings and attractive dividend yield, operating within the city gas distribution sector.
